root_cause: Windows TypedSession.Request treated GET /v1/status like POST command responses and required ok=true. The established Host status route intentionally has no ok property; the offline FakeHandler incorrectly supplied it.
correction: Accept successful /v1/status by HTTP success plus exact identity/controller validation; retain ok=true requirement for POST routes. Fake status contract now omits ok. Add real-Host read-only C# host-status-selftest before any new grant.
